dataset_meta.name: Intraday Tick Data and Statistics (GLB field set: multi-lag OHLCV)
dataset_meta.probe_method: BRAIN MCP get_datafields(region=GLB, dataset_id=pv98, delay=1, filter_sharpe=false); MINVOL1M and TOP3000 both return the same 21 fields (2026-11-17)
dataset_meta.audit_note: Stale 15-field order-book profile (mean_trade_size_1min etc., identical to USA/pv98) removed: GLB/pv98 is a multi-lag OHLCV field set; cross-region inheritance would submit unknown field names and fail every simulation.
dataset_meta.semantic_provenance: coverage/category/crowding from platform API (DECLARED); domain/is_sparse/skewness/update_frequency derived from price-volume physical units (INFERRED)

close_price_current_day_lagged_0.description: Latest session close (lag0); cross-sectional price level, strictly positive and right-skewed.

close_price_current_day_lagged_1.description: Prior session close (lag1); lag0/lag1 is a one-day return.

close_price_current_day_lagged_2.description: Two-session-old close (lag2); reference for a two-day return and short-horizon reversal.

high_price_current_day_lagged_0.description: Latest session intraday high; upper bound of the daily range.

high_price_current_day_lagged_1.description: Prior session intraday high; multi-day high break or fizzle comparison.

high_price_current_day_lagged_2.description: Two-session-old intraday high; far anchor of a three-day high path.

low_price_current_day_lagged_0.description: Latest session intraday low; high minus low is the daily range, an endogenous uncertainty scale.

low_price_current_day_lagged_1.description: Prior session intraday low; baseline for the previous range and support tests.

low_price_current_day_lagged_2.description: Two-session-old intraday low; farthest available support reference.

open_price_current_day_lagged_0.description: Latest session open; close minus open is intraday drift, open versus prior close is the overnight gap.

open_price_current_day_lagged_1.description: Prior session open; reference for a two-session overnight-gap sequence.

open_price_current_day_lagged_2.description: Two-session-old open; earliest open anchor for persistent gap studies.

volume_current_day_lagged_0.description: Latest session total volume (shares); non-negative flow, divide by market cap for turnover (endogenous normalisation, no external PV).

volume_current_day_lagged_1.description: Prior session total volume; baseline for one-day volume change and volume surprise.

volume_current_day_lagged_2.description: Two-session-old total volume; three-point volume path for attention acceleration or decay.

vwap_price_current_day_lagged_0.description: Latest session volume-weighted average price; close versus VWAP separates late-session pressure from average execution.

vwap_price_current_day_lagged_1.description: Prior session VWAP; baseline for one-day execution-price drift.

vwap_price_current_day_lagged_2.description: Two-session-old VWAP; farthest anchor of a three-point execution-price drift.

market_capitalization_current_day_lagged.description: Latest session market capitalisation; endogenous size anchor, volume divided by it gives turnover.
Prior session market capitalisation; slow-moving size anchor, ratio to lag0 gives size drift.
Two-session-old market capitalisation; longest-horizon size reference.
